about: The neutral lines of sealed notifications (refonte phase 5): the only words a push for a device with a key carries in clear (aps.alert.loc-key = the code, no title). One per journal type (docs/conversations.md §9.1). The bridge (push_runs/seal.rs TYPES), the relay (payload.rs whitelist), the iPhone app's catalog (App/Resources/Localizable.xcstrings) and Android's strings (notif_*) are checked against this file.
